Cc: NovaPlus Finance <ar@novaplus.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Order form: proposed pricing ladder + request for Net45 exception and tax evidence

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is aligned and we want to move to contract. Attached is our completed order form (NP_OrderForm_v3.pdf) with the negotiated pricing ladder and a proposed minimum commit schedule. Finance asked that we request an exception to Redwood’s standard Net30 and move to Net45 for this pilot.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept Net45 for NovaPlus corporate accounts? If not, what conditional options do you have (e.g., deposit, early payment discount)? Also, our finance team has attached a tax residency certificate (Tax_Certificate_NovaPlus.pdf) and asked that invoices be issued to: NovaPlus, Inc. (US EIN 12-3456789) — remit details to follow.

Two asks to keep things moving:
- Please confirm Redwood’s stance on the Net45 request and any required commercial compromises.
- Confirm the invoicing entity Redwood will bill and whether tax/residency evidence is sufficient.
- If acceptable, can you provide a redline of the Order Form showing any changes to minimum commit phasing?

We’re aiming to have a PO issued by 06/21 if possible.

Thanks,
Hema Patel
Procurement Lead | NovaPlus
procurement@novaplus.ai
+1 617-555-0183

Quick summary of next steps from Redwood: 
- I will upload a redline of the Order Form with a suggested minimum-commit phasing (see attached stub: RFQ_PO_example.pdf) — aim to reduce the initial period ramp from 6 months to 4 months on the first tranche.
- Kimberly to confirm whether Net45 is acceptable as-is or whether Finance requires a compromise (deposit or early-pay discount).
- We need to confirm the invoicing entity; Hema, the Tax_Certificate you sent is helpful — Kimberly, please advise if we need any additional forms (W-9/W-8 / EU VAT).

If the PO is targeted for tomorrow (06/21), can NovaPlus confirm the final billing entity and whether the PO will reference DEAL-4832 / HubSpot link below? That will speed approvals on our side.

I'll send the redline within 2 hours.

Grace / Ben — quick notes from Finance & Legal after reviewing NP_OrderForm_v3.pdf and the Tax_Certificate: 

1) Net terms: Redwood standard is Net30. We can consider Net45 only if one of the following is agreed in writing on the Order Form or an amendment:
   - 25% upfront deposit at PO, OR
   - Net45 + 2% early-payment discount if paid within 15 days, OR
   - Net45 with a credit limit (we will require a credit hold clause if payment misses 2 consecutive invoices).

2) Tax / entity: the Tax_Certificate looks OK but we need NovaPlus to confirm the legal invoicing entity exactly (full legal name, billing address, tax id). For US entities, provide a completed W-9; for non-US, provide appropriate VAT/residency docs. Until we have the completed tax form, we have to route invoices to our centralized AR team and flag withholding as TBD.

3) Minimum commit phasing: suggested compromise is the 4-month ramp Grace suggested, with a rollback clause if signal/usage < 30% of projected in month 5 — standard for pilots. Please confirm whether NovaPlus will accept that fallback.

4) PO / approvals: We require PO reference + finance contact. If NovaPlus can issue a PO with DEAL-4832 referenced on the PO, we’ll expedite invoice issuance.

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4832 (please ensure the PO references this).

I’ve attached a short comment list to the redline (internal only) but will provide an external clean redline for NovaPlus if they confirm which commercial compromise they prefer on Net45.

Kimberly Park
Director, Finance & Legal | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
+1 212-555-0110

Attachments: (internal) finance_comment_list.txt
